senses.gloss:
योधः [युध्-अच्]
1 A warrior,
soldier, combatant; सहास्मदीयैरपि
योधमुख्यैः Mb.
--2 War, battle.
--Comp.
--अगारः, --रं a soldier's
dwelling, a barrack.
--धर्मः the
law of soldiers, a military law.
--संरावः mutual defiance of combatants,
a challenge.

योधनं [युध्-भावे ल्युट्]
1 War, battle,
contest.
--2 A weapon.
--नः A
warrior, combatant.

योधिन् m. [युध्-णिनि] A warrior,
soldier, combatant.
